why: 23:11 and 23:15 are Ephron's replies but no speaker is named ('Nay, my lord, hear me' reads as Abraham); restore the two speech introductions and drop the Nahor genealogy fragment, whose 22:22 began mid-list ('And Chesed, and Hazo...') and which 24:15 makes redundant
38:28 'the one put out his hand ... his brother came out' refers to twins the reader was never told of; restore 38:27 and drop the redundant third retelling of the garment accusation in 39:18
